decision: Close the FP32 score-workspace/partition-numerator representation and reactivate the same project for a materially different on-chip streaming or recompute reduction that removes both global HBM round trips.
question: Can the exact M384 local/global paged-KV consumer retain FP32 online-softmax and value accuracy without persisting scores or partition numerators to HBM, using an SM90-legal on-chip producer/consumer, cluster, persistent, or bounded-recompute decomposition whose physical bound preserves at least 80% of the prior component time saved?

scientific_scope.producer: direct shuffled page-size-one FP8 E4M3 paged-KV gather plus BF16 extend K/V
scientific_scope.consumer: unchanged SGLang o_extend attention boundary with complete output consumption
scientific_scope.numerical_contract: FP32 online-softmax state and value accumulation until the unchanged output cast; compare against FP64 and a stock A/A envelope rather than bitwise equality

forbidden: persisting an FP32 score workspace proportional to prefix length
persisting FP32 partition numerators proportional to partitions times head_dim
replaying the consumed V2 component or endpoint
claiming endpoint safety from the sampled CPU proxy
treating occupancy, cluster launch, or fusion as an objective without an exact-consumer path
allowed_examples: SM90-legal producer/consumer specialization with on-chip score or probability handoff
thread-block clusters or persistent work queues when cluster dimensions and distributed shared-memory limits are explicit
bounded score recomputation when its added FLOPs and K/Q bytes beat the eliminated HBM traffic
a hybrid local/global decomposition when the global geometry requires a different legal mapping

required_evidence: working source through the exact producer and unchanged output consumer
complete local/global FP64 comparison and stock A/A-calibrated error characterization
explicit useful FLOPs, compulsory bytes, on-chip handoff bytes, grid waves, cluster legality, registers/shared-memory bounds, and expected roofline regime
a global and weighted lower bound that fits the preregistered 0.07205123901367187 ms global and 9.727232575416565 ms weighted loss budgets
one falsifiable predicted resource or counter movement
a lifecycle-pure new-candidate runner that invokes neither consumed V2 arm
ready_only_if: no forbidden HBM workspace is present
the numerical path improves closed-V2 error by at least one order of magnitude on complete exact geometry
the physical bound passes both global and weighted gates
the runner reaches and consumes the exact attention output

next_gpu_boundary.future_component_policy: A later director may admit one new stock-versus-streaming component measurement even if finite numerical variance remains inside its A/A-calibrated envelope; no consumed arm may replay.
